en: A historic postcard depicting a town square with several 19th-century buildings, horse-drawn carriages, and a prominent monument with a statue at the center. The buildings have signs in German, such as 'Hotel zum sächsischen Hof' and 'STADT DRESDEN HOTEL.' The lower text denotes the place as 'Sebnitz i. S. Markt mit Bismarck-Denkmal,' suggesting this is the market square with a Bismarck monument.
